messages.text:
Nobody stopped it on purpose. It was my mistake. I ran the console as a Claude Code background job, and those are killed after at most 2 hours. The last run started 06:50 (+07) and was killed at 08:50 (+07). I never noticed, so the console was down from about 08:50 until you asked me to start it at 13:17 (+07), about 4.5 hours.
Fix: since 13:20 (+07) it runs as a separate process (nohup, log in out/console-serve.log), so the 2-hour cap no longer applies. Same address, http://localhost:5559/. I now check that it is up in every lead check-in.
While it was down, no answers were lost (nothing was waiting on a running server). Still open for you: the PR-001 rev 2 decision and the two fwreskip questions in T-005 #19.
